categories.main_business_segments: Daechang Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of copper alloy products, especially brass rods and wires used as fundamental materials in semiconductor, electrical, electronic parts, automotive, shipbuilding, and industrial machinery sectors. The company also engages in related businesses through subsidiaries producing industrial and household ball valves, communication wires, and cold-rolled special steel products. Additionally, it conducts real estate leasing and sales, power generation including solar, and trading activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced melting, casting, extrusion, rolling, and forging processes for producing high-quality brass rods and copper alloy products. It emphasizes automation and state-of-the-art equipment to enhance production efficiency and product quality. Research and development focus on environmentally friendly lead-free brass alloys, corrosion-resistant materials, and new copper alloy products such as aquaculture nets with superior durability and antibacterial properties.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Daechang serves a broad range of industries including semiconductor, electrical and electronic components, automotive, shipbuilding, and industrial machinery manufacturing. Its products are essential base materials for both heavy chemical industries and light industries producing consumer goods. The company has a strong domestic customer base with over 400 companies and exports to approximately 20 countries including the USA, China, Southeast Asia, Australia, New Zealand, Europe, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Siheung and Dangjin. It has overseas subsidiaries and sales offices in the USA and China (Shanghai and Shenzhen) and exports extensively to Asia, North America, Europe, and Oceania. Its global footprint covers about 20 countries, focusing on expanding market share in key international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Daechang operates primarily in the midstream segment of the copper alloy supply chain, focusing on processing raw materials like brass scrap and zinc into semi-finished products such as brass rods and wires. It sources raw materials globally, leveraging a stable procurement network, and supplies processed materials to downstream manufacturers in various industries. The company also engages in downstream activities through subsidiaries involved in finished product manufacturing and trading.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D on environmentally friendly, lead-free brass alloys and high-performance copper alloys to meet tightening global environmental regulations and evolving industry needs. It invests in developing new materials like corrosion-resistant aquaculture nets and high-strength alloys for electric vehicle components. Ongoing projects include thermoelectric power generation systems and advanced alloy development in collaboration with research institutes and industry partners, aiming to enhance product competitiveness and open new markets.
categories.revenue_model: Daechang generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured copper alloy products, especially brass rods, and related processed goods. It also earns income from trading activities, real estate leasing and sales, and power generation. Export sales constitute nearly half of total revenue, with domestic sales and real estate development contributing the remainder. The company maintains pricing linked to international raw material prices to manage cost fluctuations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the domestic brass rod market, Daechang holds a leading position with approximately 45% market share, competing mainly against Poongsan Corporation and other smaller firms. The company is recognized for superior product quality, price competitiveness, and reliable delivery, positioning it strongly against both domestic and international competitors. Its extensive sales network and advanced production capabilities create high entry barriers for new competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Daechang reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.32 trillion KRW with a recent decline due to challenging economic conditions. The company experienced an operating loss in 2023 but maintains substantial asset base around 759 billion KRW and equity of about 250 billion KRW. Despite short-term setbacks, Daechang has a stable financial structure with ongoing investments in production capacity and R&D, aiming for sustainable growth and profitability recovery.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daechang emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly copper alloy products with advanced technological features such as lead-free and corrosion-resistant brass alloys. Its competitive advantages include a robust global procurement network, automated and efficient production processes, and a broad product portfolio tailored to diverse industrial applications. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality certifications, and strong customer relationships underpin its market leadership and brand reputation.
